# Pragma Research

Pragma Research is a frontier mathematics company that works on physics, artificial general intelligence and the nature of reality. One mathematical result carries all three: the universe is generated by a decentralised consensus process among bounded observers, and the same process generates thoughts. The physics program proves it, the simulator runs it, and Cadence builds brains on it. A third program, physical engineering (optical compute, materials, propulsion), is at the horizon stage.

## Fundamental physics: Observer Patch Holography (OPH)

OPH is a proven implementation of simulation theory. It reverse engineers the hardware (twelve-port observer patches) and the software (record, compare, repair, agree) that generate our observations and the universe. Quantum probability, thermodynamics, 3+1 spacetime, the Standard Model gauge structure and fixed-point equations for the constants come out as consequences; 10,944 Lean theorems with zero admitted proofs check the mathematics. The papers classify results separately as exact finite theorems, results conditional on named premises, and comparisons with measurement.

- Program overview: https://floatingpragma.io/physics/
- Preprint (PhilPapers): https://philpapers.org/rec/MUEFOC
- Paper library with HTML and PDF editions: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/
- Machine-readable paper inventory: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/papers.json
- Paper LLM index: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/llms.txt
- Textbooks and guided learning: https://learn.floatingpragma.io/
- Book for general readers: https://oph-book.floatingpragma.io/
- Collaborative source repository: https://github.com/FloatingPragma/observer-patch-holography/
- Mini-universe simulation (rendered from real simulator data): https://simulation.floatingpragma.io/

- Interactive lab: https://oph-lab.floatingpragma.io/
- Essay, Thinking Is All There Is: https://medium.com/@muellerberndt/thinking-is-all-there-is-d7c72969bf8d

## AGI: Cadence

Cadence is an open-source (MIT) Python library researching general intelligence through overlap consensus, equilibrium detuning and functional self-reflection. Bounded observer-like patches hold local state, publish values at declared ports, read their neighbours and repair what experience contradicts. TemporalPatchNet learns observed paths and carries context between observations, TemporalMemory protects selected acquired responses while other directions keep learning, and the same learned model repairs continuous action proposals privately before an action is executed. Learning runs on local activity contrasts, with no backward pass, no training switch and no frozen weights. What it makes possible: flexible learners that learn through experience, embodied AGI with a small brain inside the machine, and robots that keep learning new tasks and improving at them on the job.

- Program overview: https://floatingpragma.io/cadence/
- Library: https://github.com/muellerberndt/cadence
- Package: https://pypi.org/project/cadence-net/ (pip install cadence-net)
- Documentation: https://github.com/muellerberndt/cadence/blob/main/docs/index.md
- Paper, with the controlled results and their assumptions: https://floatingpragma.io/cadence/paper.pdf
- Bundled Lean proofs, 169 conditional theorems: https://github.com/muellerberndt/cadence/tree/main/lean
